name: //Träumerei Nocturne
original_name: //トロイメライ・ノクターン
source:
"I would like you to weave the possibilities of the haishi."

You suddenly realize you are standing on a quiet lakeshore.
On a soundless moonlit night, streetlights line the shore.

Beyond the trees as you turn around, there is a single bookstore.
— Welcome to the "Hoshiyomi Bookstore," where the haishi of the stars are woven.

A visual novel in which you weave stories at a bookstore that records the haishi (unofficial histories) of the stars.

The stories you record may not be stories that actually happened.
Yet there must surely be real meaning in weaving the possibilities of such stories.

What, in the end, did your choices mean?

Endings: As many as the endings of each story multiplied together.
Estimated play time: Around 3–6 hours. However, the time it takes to finish reading the stories might be called eternal.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/14873]Novelgame[/url]]
